messages:
Ivy Park: Heads-up 1 - Helio Health (midmarket) dropped 62% usage overnight. Trial ends in 9 days. Thinking of testing a 'concierge rewind' play: a low-friction rewind to last-working-state + guided micro-lab.

Jonah Lee: curious what 'rewind' means operationally?

Ivy Park: two parts: (1) portal sets account into 'rewind' read-only snapshot of last 14 days of activity and preserves data for 30 days; (2) we assign a concierge engineer for a 30-min live lab to restore their pipeline and finish the import. The goal is to remove pressure and demonstrate 1 quick success.

Marta Ruiz: love that. Any cost/credit ask?

Ivy Park: propose 1800 token credit + expedited support for 10 days. Small cost but high signal. Also add a short in-lab poll: reason choices = csv mapping / auth / perf / don't see value / other.

concierge-bot: Action created: create_account_state 'rewind_snapshot' -> assignee Marta Ruiz.

Marta Ruiz: I'll create the portal snapshot button and two templates: (A) rewind offer email, (B) reactivation nudge. Will add a GIF showing the import fix.

Jonah Lee: instrumentation: we need events `rewind_activated`, `concierge_lab_booked`, `snapshot_restored`, `first_success_after_rewind`. Tagging @Billing Ops for token provisioning.

Billing Ops: noted. Approve up to 2000 tokens per playbook case. Need template for how to claim.

Ivy Park: draft email snippet: 
```
Hi {{first_name}},
We saw your recent activity drop and want to make this low-friction. We can rewind your trial to the last working snapshot and schedule a 30-min concierge lab to finish the import. We'll also grant 1800 token credit and priority support for 10 days. Book here: {{calendly_link}}. Reply to accept the rewind.
```

Jonah Lee: nice. Add explicit checklist in booking confirmation: submit sample CSV, try the one-click test harness, and attach the GIF.

Marta Ruiz: adding the test harness link and a short pre-lab checklist. I'll instrument a 1-click 'mark ready' so the concierge can prep.

Ivy Park: follow-up cadence: immediate email, 48-hour lab window, 6-day reminder, and 2-day pre-snapshot-expiry alert to CSM. If `first_success_after_rewind` fires, CSM does a 1:1 within 48 hours.

concierge-bot: Reminder: calendly link missing for Helio Health (assigned to Marta Ruiz).

Marta Ruiz: calendly + GIF added. Pushing templates to playbook doc and creating a short rubric: use concierge-rewind for accounts with recent regressions and an identifiable last-working window; prefer soft-save if billing already set or usage is steady but low.

Ivy Park: tagging Jonah for dashboards. Please create a cohort card for 'rewind_trials' and surface the four events.

Jonah Lee: will add a dashboard card and a weekly rollup metric.

Ivy Park: final checklist before outreach: templates (Marta), calendly (Marta), snapshot flag tested (Marta), token provisioning flow (Billing Ops), events wired (Jonah), kickoff DM to customer (Ivy).

Billing Ops: will enable provisioning flow and add accounting line.

Ivy Park: update 1768610300 - Helio Health replied, accepted rewind and booked Tue 9am. Running play tomorrow; will post results here. :white_check_mark:
